name: Honda CB92 Benly Super Sport
engine: 125 cc air-cooled overhead-cam twin, one carb, four-speed
intro: Honda's first sport bike. A pressed-steel frame, a leading-link fork and parts that are hard to find.

L: The leading-link fork pivots on bushings. Check for play and grease it before you trust the steering.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
